task.description: WF-02 Step 1: produce the design artefact for REQ-034 (Definition export/import, export_import.zig PD-09). Branch feature/WF02-REQ034-20260817 already exists and is checked out. Write lib/letflow/design/export_import.md covering a new Letflow.Definitions.ExportImport module that calls REQ-030's Store (lib/letflow/definitions/store.ex or lib/letflow/definitions.ex, whichever REQ-030 actually created -- read it first) and REQ-028/029's validators. Read docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-034 entry in full, plus REQ-030's entry for the create/1 signature this design must call into, plus docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md and the relevant stage-2 migration doc.
acceptance_criteria: export/1 signature specified: input (definition identity), output (ExportDocument struct/map shape: bpm_export_schema_version, id, name, version, description, graph, exported_at)

import/1 signature specified: input (ExportDocument), output ({:ok, definition} | {:error, reason}) -- must specify it generates a NEW id (never reuses source id), calls REQ-030's create/1 (or equivalent) so REQ-028/029 validation is re-run with no bypass, and rejects a mismatched bpm_export_schema_version with a distinct error reason from generic validation failure
graph field round-trip fidelity addressed explicitly (export/1's graph output must be byte-for-byte comparable back through import/1)
each of REQ-034's 4 acceptance criteria maps to a concrete design element, no TBD/deferral
no implementation code in the design doc -- signatures and type shapes only

result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/export_import.md for REQ-034 (Letflow.Definitions.ExportImport). Design covers: EXPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION module attribute ("bpm/definition/v1"); export/2(id, opts) -> {:ok, ExportDocument.t()} | {:error, :not_found} | common_error(), delegating to REQ-030's get_by_id/2, copying name/version/description/graph verbatim plus a fresh exported_at timestamp; ExportDocument struct (bpm_export_schema_version, id [informational only], name, version, description, graph [string-keyed map, never Graph.t() struct form], exported_at); import/3(document, imported_by, opts) -> {:ok, ProcessDefinition.t()} | import_error(), which checks bpm_export_schema_version first (distinct {:error, {:unknown_schema_version, actual}}), then builds create_attrs() deliberately omitting :id (so create/2's autogenerated primary key always wins) and delegates 100% of graph/attribute/edge validation to REQ-030's create/2 (no direct Graph module calls, no bypass). Byte-for-byte graph round-trip fidelity (INV-EI-3) is achieved by passing definition.graph/document.graph through unmodified at every step, relying on create/2's confirmed behavior of casting the raw attrs[:graph] map (not the struct-converted form) into the DB. No new DB tables/columns/migrations -- reuses REQ-027's process_definitions table. Added imported_by as a new required parameter (not named in REQ-034's text) since create/2 requires :created_by and ExportDocument carries no creator identity -- flagged as a reasoned, non-guessed addition (design doc section 4.3). 4 open questions recorded explicitly (OQ-1..OQ-4): JSON (de)serialization scope, exported_at precision, imported_by's eventual source, and confirming no extra duplicate-content check is added beyond create/2's existing uq_definition_version enforcement. All 4 REQ-034 acceptance criteria mapped to concrete design elements in section 10's traceability table. No implementation code (.ex bodies) present -- only @type/@spec blocks and numbered pipeline-step prose, matching req030/req041's established design-doc convention.
